notes.title: JUNE UPDATE: The Power of Music in The Occultist
notes.content:
June 21st marks European Music Day, and we couldn’t imagine a better moment to unveil something we’ve been waiting to share with you: the main theme from the official trailer of The Occultist.


🎼 A Sound That Summons the Spirit of GodStone
Composed by the brilliant Pepe Herrero and recorded with a live orchestra, this piece sets the tone for everything The Occultist stands for:

A deep emotional current. A creeping sense of dread. And just a flicker of hope.

The theme was created hand-in-hand with the game’s narrative and worldbuilding, it’s not just music; it’s a mirror of the story.


🎧 Listen to the trailer theme here:

[previewyoutube="5JbZdvfmQpY;full"][/previewyoutube]
The music in The Occultist plays a critical role in creating tension, wonder, and emotional weight. This theme is just the first of many original pieces being composed for the game, each one tied to specific locations, events, or characters.



You’ll hear music shift as you uncover secrets, feel it pulse during crucial moments in the story, and fall silent in the moments where silence says everything.



We’d love to hear your thoughts! What feelings or images did this theme evoke for you? Let us know in the comments!



DALOAR Team

notes.title: MONTHLY UPDATES: APRIL
notes.content:
The Occultist: April Updates👻📿

We’re back with another monthly update for The Occultist, and we’ve got some exciting news to share! This time, we’re diving into one of the most essential tools in the game—your Diary. Plus, we’ve got something HUGE to celebrate: The Occultist has won Best in Play at GDC 2025!

📖 The Diary: Your tool for discovering the unknown 📖

In The Occultist, investigation is key to uncovering the mysteries of the island. To help you with this, you’ll have access to a Diary. It’s more than just a collection of notes—it’s your personal guide through the secrets of GodStone.


Investigation: This section records all the relevant information you discover throughout the story. Every found object, important conversation, or crucial detail will be stored here, making it easier to solve puzzles.

Story: As you progress, this section will fill up with details about the events surrounding the island and its mysterious past. It will be crucial for connecting the dots and understanding twhat happened in this lost island.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137475/dd40441aa155e2cb08836a3bcff9f6ef3b819d5d.gif

This Diary will be your best ally in keeping track of your investigation and fully immersing yourself in the game’s narrative.


🏆 We won the Best in Play at GDC 2025

March was an unforgettable month for us. We had the incredible opportunity to showcase The Occultist at the Game Developers Conference (GDC) 2025, where we met amazing developers and guess what? We took home the Best in Play GDC 2025 award!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137475/caf51597da6bae73b6db5958a2b01314ba5e557a.png

That’s it for this month’s update! As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts—what do you think about the Diary? 📖 Let us know in the comments!


DALOAR Team

notes.title: THE OCCULTIST NEW GAMEPLAY TRAILER / NACON CONNECT
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As indie developers developing our first game, this is a really special moment for us, and we couldn't be more excited to share it with you. The Occultist has been featured at Nacon Connect. To be able to be part of this event alongside so many amazing projects is an honor, and we're incredibly grateful for this opportunity which we would like to thank Daedalic and Nacon for.

After years of hard work, we’re thrilled to finally unveil our NEW Gameplay Trailer! This latest preview showcases never-before-seen gameplay, deeper horror elements, and an atmospheric experience that we can't wait for you to dive into.

📽️ Watch the new Nacon Connect presentation:
[previewyoutube=PaE-gJvE2e0;full][/previewyoutube]

This trailer is more than just a sneak peek. It’s a reflection of all the passion, and effort that has gone into development of our game. 

In our new trailer you will see:

🏘️ New GodStone locations
🙍‍♂️ Key Characters
📿 New Pendulum Abilities
And much more...

👀 And check out the full NEW Gameplay Trailer here:
[previewyoutube=LloYPdO2exE;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think in the comments, and stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you for being part of this journey with us! 📿

DALOAR Team

notes.title: MONTHLY POST OF THE OCCULTIST: FEBRUARY
notes.content:
The Occultist: February Images👻📿

The story of GodStone remains shrouded in mystery... but its eerie locations are starting to emerge.
This month, we’re unveiling new exclusive images showcasing some of the haunting spaces you'll encounter in The Occultist.

🏚️ Desolate children’s rooms,
🚪 A chilling hospital hallway,
🌊 And the interior of a mariner-style house.

GodStone seems to have been a great island, and every corner is designed to tell a story.

⚠️ No spoilers here—just a glimpse of the art, detail, and unsettling atmosphere we've created.

notes.title: THE OCCULTIST Countdown Begins! 🕯️
notes.content:
2025: The year of The Occultist👻📿

The wait is almost over: The Occultist launches this year! To build anticipation, we'd like to take you inside the island of GodStone with a series of exclusive monthly articles.

Each month, we'll unveil never-before-seen images showcasing the art, mystery and chilling atmosphere of The Occultist.

⚠️ Don't worry, there are no story spoilers here. We'll just immerse you in the eerie and detailed world we've created.
